remarks: Perched in the heart of vibrant Studio City, Unit 306 at 12603 Moorpark St. is a masterclass in modern, light-filled living. This pristine corner residence boasts soaring ceilings and a comprehensive 2021 remodel that balances style with high-end functionality. From the moment you step onto the Canadian white oak floors with cork underlay, the attention to detail is evident. The kitchen features sleek quartz countertops and custom cabinetry, while both bathrooms have been thoughtfully redesigned.
